preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains an integer t, and the total number of lines in stdin is exactly t + 1.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= len(s) <= 100 and s.count('(') == 1 and s.count(')') == 1 and all(c in '()?' for c in s) for s in t_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s has length between 2 and 100, contains exactly one '(' and exactly one ')', and consists only of characters '(', ')', and '?'.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().upper() in ('YES', 'NO') for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a case-insensitive 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().upper() == 'YES') == (len(s) % 2 == 0 and s[0] == '(' and s[-1] == ')') for line, s in zip(stdout_lines, t_lines[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if the string length is even, the first character is '(', and the last character is ')'; otherwise it is 'NO'.
